title: Creeper Warning
description: cat warns u when creeper is nearby. thats it. thats the mod.
body:
ok so basically u know when ur mining or building or whatever and then BOOM u die to a creeper that u didnt even see?? yeah thats the worst. this mod fixes that by adding a little guy (cat) who tells u when theres a creeper nearby.

### how it works (very technical trust me)
- creeper within 10 blocks = warning signs in corners start blinking
- creeper within 5 blocks = cat appears and says "watch out bro..."
- thats literally it i didnt make this complicated

### features (if u can even call them that)
- corner warnings that blink (so u cant miss them unless ur blind)
- cat with speech bubble (hes trying his best)
- configurable distances in case 10 blocks is too close or too far idk ur preference
- works on fabric 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 (i suffered with the gradle so u dont have to)

### why u need this
look im not gonna sit here and write a whole essay about why creepers are bad we all know they suck. they sneak up on u, they blow up ur stuff, they ruin ur day. this mod just... tells u theyre there. thats the whole thing.

### known issues
- none its perfect (probably)
- if it crashes its not my fault its mojangs fault probably
- actually if it crashes tell me i guess but no promises

### credits
- me for making it
- the cat for doing his job
- u for downloading this thing
